description: The application chooses no instance UID: the client makes one up, and keeps it across a restart. The first run is long: a client must store the UID it made up durably before it sends it, and on a cold, busy ARC runner that first write has taken more than 4 s. The second run is long too: a Java client on such a runner has taken more than 4 s from its start to its first message.
